text:
tariq: FYI link-scan just flagged a couple of broken anchors in /eng-runtime/runbook. quick patchable but wanted to check ownership before I jump in. @maria usually handles runbook touchups right?

docs-bot: automated-scan results: 2 broken anchor links in /eng-runtime/runbook (references to #serving-runtime changed) detected at 1763015900. Affected pages: /guides/runtime/operationalize.md, /howto/kv-cache.md

maria: yep i can take this. looks like the section heading was renamed in evan's refactor last week (PR #3987). i'll grep for the old anchor and prepare a tiny PR to update refs.

evan: yep that was me, sorry — moved heading from "Serving runtime" -> "Runtime serving" to match style. my bad for not leaving a redirect anchor.

maria: quick local check i ran: `rg "#serving-runtime|\[.*#serving-runtime" -n docs/ | sed -n '1,50p'` shows two hits. i'll replace references with `#runtime-serving` and add an HTML anchor fallback comment in the mdx so old links still work for a bit.

maria: opening PR now with a short changelist: 1) update anchors in the two docs 2) add <!-- legacy-anchor: serving-runtime --> above new heading 3) add CODEOWNERS mention for /eng-runtime/runbook. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4210

tariq: thanks. can you also add a one-line note in the runbook frontmatter about preferred anchor format? keeps future renames less painful.

maria: good call — will add `preferred_anchor_format: kebab-case-heading` as a frontmatter hint.

ops: FYI we've seen a small uptick in edge 404s because some external partners still reference the old anchor. if we need to be safe for a while, we can add a redirect in CDN for `/#serving-runtime` -> `/#runtime-serving`. takes ~10m to deploy.

evan: i'd prefer the HTML fallback comment first (so both old and new work in-page) and then ops redirect as backup. if PR merges today we can schedule the CDN redirect for next week and monitor.

maria: PR opened and added smoke tests in the description (`rg` results + local mdx preview). tagging @tariq and @evan for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4210

tariq: quick CR: LGTM, just remove an accidental whitespace in the frontmatter. left a tiny inline comment.

evan: approved. added one optional nit about anchor wording but not blocking.

maria: merged and triggered docs preview build.

deploy-bot: docs-preview: build triggered by PR #4210 01763017400, status: success

maria: verified previews for /guides/runtime/operationalize and /howto/kv-cache. both anchors resolve and legacy comment present. i'll open a follow-up ops ticket for CDN redirect next week to catch external refs.

ops: noted, created ticket OPS-1358 to add CDN redirect next Tue and monitor logs.

maria: closing thread 176017650 01763017650 — thanks all. will watch OPS-1358 for rollout and re-run link-scan next Friday.
